artifact_review: The Router identified two artifacts: texture anomaly (severity 2) and structural collapse/melting (severity 1). I agree with the texture anomaly assessment; the yellow patches do look slightly 'painted on' or noisy compared to the organic black skin. The 'structural collapse' at the tail boundary is supported by the visual evidence of soft edges blending into the leaves. The Perceptual Quality Auditor noted 'slight compression' (score 0.2), which aligns with the minor noise/graininess observed. The Topology Boundary Auditor gave a high confidence score (0.97), which suggests the main body is coherent, but this does not rule out the subtle edge bleeding noted by the Router in the darker tail region where contrast is low. I will maintain the severity ratings but emphasize that the edge bleeding is a common AI artifact in high-frequency backgrounds.
